title: Install checks required tools and repairs owned PATH blocks automatically for login, interactive, non-login and SSH shells; only failures need a screen.
verification: Scripted source tests cover automatic advance, failure, retry and shell receipts. PATH regressions cover per-context winners, a late interactive Bash override, owned-block repair and repeat idempotence without changing user configuration or launchers. Deployed conflict/correction observation remains owed in the shared installer regression.
